regions.merged_text: Tomorrow is the Vigil of the glorious Assumption of Mary our B1. Mother. Thank God! How privileged we are in being able to say so much! How little we can possibly appreciate her in this poor exile from Heaven !. You asked me sometime back about what Rae should do with certain money given him for promoting the "Mystical City." ..... Until about a year ago I had hoped that he would eventually be the publisher. However; when Jerry called me from Notre Dame and I was tempted to ask to speak to his Father - who I knew was there waiting to speak to me - I changed my view. It came to me immediately after that something like as follows: "God chooses the weak things of the world .... to do His greatest works. ." What Humiliations did not V.M.M. of Agreda meet before succeeding in writing the out standing master- piece the 2nd time!" It became clear that little K.S. wished to help L.W. Bern'kn. Only in conjunction with L.W.B. it seems to me for the present may one hope to help . Only in harmony and in conjunction with L.B. may anyone hope to get any where. I ought to rewrite this but you will understand ... I am sure. . . ·
